members.name: PolygonMeanValueWeights
members.signature: public static bool PolygonMeanValueWeights(Float3 point, IReadOnlyList<Float3> polygon, float[] weights)

docs.summary: Computes generalized barycentric coordinates of a point with respect to a planar polygon using Mean Value Coordinates (Floater 2003). The weights form a partition of unity (sum to 1) and reproduce the polygon's vertices, so they can interpolate any per-vertex quantity. The point is inside the polygon when every weight is non-negative; weights may be negative for points outside, which makes this usable as a containment test as well.
docs.returns: False if the polygon is degenerate or the weights buffer is too small.

params.point: The query point, assumed to lie on (or close to) the polygon's plane.
params.polygon: The polygon's ordered vertices (convex or concave, 3 or more).
params.weights: Output weights, one per polygon vertex; length must be at least polygon.Count.
